definitions.explanation: A gathering of people to discuss matters, make decisions, or exchange information. Common in business and organizational settings.

examples.japanese: {三|さん}{時|じ}から{会議|かいぎ}があります。
{会議|かいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}してください。
{会議|かいぎ}は{何時|なんじ}に{終|お}わりますか。
examples.english: What time does the meeting end?

notes:
Can be used with する: {会議|かいぎ}する (to hold a meeting).

Related words: {会議室|かいぎしつ} (meeting room/conference room). Often used in business Japanese: {会議|かいぎ}に{出|で}る (attend a meeting), {会議|かいぎ}を{開|ひら}く (hold a meeting).
